description: The [CATALOG-CALL ...] line of one stored tool call, shared by artifact-access (Go, workspace_list) and agent-runtime (Java, ThreadCatalog, the review catalog). Each case maps the object's key and headers to the line, without the trailing started=<time> field that only workspace_list adds. A missing header is unknown (a missing Content-Type is unknown, a missing size header is the object's size). argsSummaries are cases of the arguments summary alone, which may hold characters a NATS header cannot.

cases.name: a JSON list
cases.line: [CATALOG-CALL key=k8s/001-pods_list tool=pods_list args={"namespace":"kube-system"} type=application/json rows=3 bytes=2210 error=false]

cases.name: a kubectl table has no row count
cases.line: [CATALOG-CALL key=k8s/002-pods_list tool=pods_list args={} type=text/plain; profile=kubectl-table rows=unknown bytes=15210 error=false]

cases.name: a failed call
cases.line: [CATALOG-CALL key=k8s/003-pods_list tool=pods_list args={"a":1} type=application/json rows=unknown bytes=40 error=true]

cases.name: an object stored before Content-Type and the size header existed
cases.line: [CATALOG-CALL key=k8s/004-logs tool=logs args={} type=unknown rows=unknown bytes=900 error=false]

cases.name: runs of spaces are folded to one, brackets become parentheses
cases.line: [CATALOG-CALL key=k8s/005-x tool=x args={"names": ("a", "b")} type=text/plain rows=unknown bytes=5 error=false]

cases.name: long arguments are cut at 60 characters
cases.line: [CATALOG-CALL key=k8s/006-x tool=x args={"q":"aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa... type=text/plain rows=unknown bytes=5 error=false]

cases.name: a row count that is not a number is unknown
cases.line: [CATALOG-CALL key=k8s/007-x tool=x args={} type=text/plain rows=unknown bytes=5 error=false]

cases.name: whitespace-only arguments are an empty object
cases.line: [CATALOG-CALL key=k8s/008-x tool=x args={} type=text/plain rows=unknown bytes=5 error=false]

cases.name: tabs between words are folded
cases.line: [CATALOG-CALL key=k8s/009-x tool=x args={"a": 1} type=text/plain rows=unknown bytes=5 error=false]

argsSummaries.name: only spaces is an empty object
white space is folded and the ends are trimmed
a no-break space is not folded
an em space is not folded
accented characters are cut by character
an astral character counts as one character and is never split
an astral character at the cut
